description: Zero-QPU WP0 check: solution-quality cost of each existing OPS violation (report Section 3.2 OPS table). For each violated (instance, shots) combination, compares best-feasible-bitstring AR and feasible-shot fraction evaluated from the ALREADY-COLLECTED hardware counts at the hardware argmin grid cell vs. at the ideal-sim argmin grid cell. No new QPU time used.
method: best_feasible uses hardware counts_hardware at the given grid cell; AR = best_feasible_energy / e_optimal (brute-force exact optimum). feasible_frac = fraction of hardware shots at that cell satisfying sum(x)=k.
headline: Across all 6 OPS-violated combinations, best-feasible AR at the hardware argmin differs from AR at the ideal argmin by at most 0.0002 (all values >= 0.9997, most = 1.0000). The solution-quality cost of an OPS violation, measured the standard way (best feasible sample, not grid-average energy), is negligible in every case tested here.
